text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN/SOYMEAL SALE - China has bought at least 200,000 tonnes each of soybeans and soymeal for July-Sept shipment. Mixed origin U.S. and South American beans had been purchased in the low $320s inclusive of cost and freight (C&F) to Chinese ports. Meal was priced at $290-295 per tonne C&F.

BARLEY SALE - Iran bought 100,000 tonnes of optional origin Sept barley at around $148 per tonne. The price unusually includes freight and works out at a FOB price estimated somewhere near $128 per tonne, depending on origin.

CORN/WHEAT SALE - The Swiss firm Glencore won a third Bulgarian wheat import tender for 53,000 tonnes of bread wheat at $156.35 per tonne, deputy agriculture minister Valya Savcheva said. Bulgarian private firm Inpro won the tender to import 10,000 tonnes of feed maize. "Inpro proposed the lowest price of $139.70 per tonne of maize to be delivered by July 5," Savcheva said.

WHEAT SALE - Syria's general establishment for cereal processing and trade (GECPT) has sold Algeria 25,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for August delivery, a GECPT official told Reuters. He did not reveal the price.

WHEAT TENDERS - Guyana is tendering on Thursday for 2,300 tonnes of spring wheat, 1,000 tonnes of soft red winter and 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter under the PL-480 program, agents for the buyer said. Shipment was slated for July 4-26.
- The CCC said it was tendering on June 17 for up to 5,080 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Kenya. Shipment was slated for July 1-25.

CORN TENDER - Privatised Egyptian Starch and Glucose said it was seeking 10,000 tonnes +/- 25 percent buyers option of yellow corn of Egyptian, U.S. or Argentinian origin. The firm said the deadline for bids was Thursday, June 12.

SOYBEAN TENDER - The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association will tender on Wednesday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. or South American soybeans, traders said. If from the U.S. then shipment will be either August 1-15 (U.S. Gulf) or August 16-30 (Pacific Northwest). If from South America, shipment was slated for July 26 to August 14.

RICE TENDER - The Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by June 16 for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati variety Pak-7 1996/97 (July-June) rice containing seven percent broken.

VEGOIL AND TALLOW TENDERS - El Salvador seeks 4,500 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and about 1,000 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 export program for July 20-August 5 shipment. Offers are to be received by June 16. El Salvador also seeks on June 16 about 1,650 tonnes of tallow and about 800 tonnes of top white tallow. Shipment dates were set for July 20-August 5.

MARKET TALK - China is expected to import around one million tonnes of Malaysian palm oil in 1997, after a significant drop in purchases last year, the director of the Malaysian Palm Oil Promotion Council said.

MARKET TALK (cont.) - Preferential maize imports into Spain will again be the focus at the European Union's cereals management committee meeting on Thursday, as all other 1996/97 grain tenders have ended, EU officials said.
